scripts.lint: eslint packages apps evals scripts/live-run tools
scripts.stack:up: docker compose up -d --build --remove-orphans && docker image prune -f --filter label=com.docker.compose.project=ai-interview
scripts.stack:logs: docker compose logs -f --tail=100 api worker web
scripts.stack:clean: docker compose down --remove-orphans && docker image rm -f aidp-server aidp-web ai-interview-api ai-interview-migrate ai-interview-worker ai-interview-web; docker image prune -f --filter label=com.docker.compose.project=ai-interview
scripts.db:up: docker compose up -d --wait postgres && DATABASE_URL=postgresql://app:app@localhost:5432/ai_discovery pnpm --filter @aidp/db exec prisma migrate deploy && echo 'export DATABASE_URL=postgresql://app:app@localhost:5432/ai_discovery'
